programme.title: Y Pitws Bychain
programme.desc: Mae'r Pitws Bychain yn mynd i weld Syrcas Chwain ac yn gyffrous iawn - ond mae Macsen yn taro'r llwyfan ar ddamwain! The Wee Littles are going to a Flea circus, and are very excited!

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.desc: Straeon lliwgar o Affrica am anifeiliaid y byd. Heddiw cawn glywed pam nad oes blew gan Hipo. Today we find out why Hippo has no hair.

programme.title: Ahoi!
programme.desc: Ysgol y Cwm sy'n ymuno â Ben Dant a Cadi i herio'r byd y tro 'ma. Ysgol y Cwm joins Ben Dant and Cadi for a little adventure.

programme.title: Sion y Chef
programme.desc: Mae Siôn ac Izzy'n gwarchod Bea ond maen nhw'n tynnu gwallt o'u pennau pan mae'n crïo'n ddiddiwedd. Siôn and Izzy offer to babysit Baby Bea, but a crying baby proves to be quite a handful.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach...
programme.desc: Byddwn yn teithio i Baris i ddysgu am Pierre Lallement, y dyn wnaeth greu'r beic gyda phedalau nol yn 1863. We learn how bikes work and about the different types, such as motorbikes.

programme.title: Caban Banana Gareth
programme.desc: Mi fydd Gareth yr Orangutan yn teithio ysgolion ledled Cymru yn trafod pob math o bynciau. Wythnos yma, Gwyliau ydi'r pwnc trafod. This week, Holiday is the topic of discussion.

programme.title: Blero'n Mynd i Ocido
programme.desc: Mae'r igian sydd ar Blero'n achosi tirlithriad. Fydd e'n gallu dod o hyd i'w ffordd adre? Blero's hiccups cause a landslide. Can he stop and find his way home?

programme.title: Byd Tad-cu
programme.desc: Mae Lewis yn holi, 'Beth yw Mellt a Tharanau' a dyma Tad-cu'n dechrau ar stori sili arall am chwilen o'r enw Cranogwen oedd yn ofn y glaw. Today, Lewis asks: what is thunder and lightning?

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Ar drip i'r traeth mae Pablo a'r anifeiliaid yn canu cân, ond pam bod cefnder Draff yn mynnu eu gwahardd rhag gwneud? Pablo is off to the beach when he and the animals decide to sing a song.

programme.title: New: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae teulu swnllyd yn cyrraedd Parc Glan Gwil ac yn creu trafferth. Mae'n rhaid i'r criw feddwl am ffordd o'u tawelu. A noisy family arrive in Parc Glan Gwil and create trouble.

programme.title: Byd Carlo Bach
programme.desc: A wnaiff map Carlo ei arwain at drysor y môr-ladron? Wil Carlo's map lead him to the pirates' treasure?

programme.title: Sam Tan
programme.desc: Mae Sara isie neud fideo roc o Trefor Ifans a'i iwcalele. Mae pethau'n mynd o chwith a Sam yw'r seren ond mae Trefor yn rocio! Sarah wants to make a rock video of Trevor and his ukulele.

programme.title: Jambori
programme.desc: Ymunwch â Jam ar daith llawn synau, cerddoriaeth a lluniau lliwgar - gyda hwyaid yn dawnsio yn y bath, drws hudol yn y parc a chath yn coginio cacen. Welcome to a new series of Jamborî.

programme.title: Digbi Draig
programme.desc: Mae Digbi'n tybio y bydd Betsi wrth ei bodd efo'r Bocs Triciau mae wedi dod o hyd iddo yn siop Abel. Digbi thinks Betsi will be delighted with the Box of Tricks he found in Abel's store.

programme.title: Jen a Jim a'r Cywiadur
programme.desc: "Wwww" a "Eeee" yw rhai o'r synau rhyfedd sy'n dod o'r fferm heddiw, ond beth sy'n anarferol amdanyn nhw? "Wwww" and "Eeee" are some of the strange sounds coming from the farm today!

programme.title: Anifeiliaid Bach y Byd
programme.desc: Yn y rhaglen hon, anifeiliaid sy'n dda am gydweddu a'u hamgylchedd sy'n cael y sylw - sef y morgathod a'r llewpard. In this programme, we meet the ray and the leopard.

programme.title: Octonots
programme.desc: Mae'r criw yn brwydro i achub haid o ddolffiniaid troelli sy'n ymddangos eu bod yn nofio yn eu cwsg. A struggle to save a pod of spinner dolphins who seem to be swimming in their sleep.

programme.title: Odo
programme.desc: Helpa Odo Pen Bandit i glirio ac ail agor y llwybrau Natur sy wedi cau o gwmpas Maes y Mes. Odo helps Camp Leader to clear and open up some Nature trails.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Cyflymder sy'n denu Jet-boi, ond mae Jet-dad eisio iddo roi cynnig ar rywbeth newydd. As Cwstenin Cranc interrupts Jet-boy and Jet-dad's practice, an opportunity emerges.

programme.title: Waw! - Y Corff
programme.desc: Y corff sy'n cael sylw Awi a chriw Waw y tro yma. The body gets the attention of Awi and the crew.

programme.title: Y Pitws Bychain
programme.desc: Mae'n fore oer yn y ddôl ac mae'r Pitws Bychain am wneud dillad cynnes efo help dafad gyfeillgar. It's a cold morning, and The Wee Littles decide that they should make some warmer clothes.

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.desc: Straeon lliwgar o Affrica am anifieiliad y byd. Heddiw cawn glywed pam mae gan Tsita ddagrau. Today we find out why Cheetah has tears.

programme.title: Ahoi!
programme.desc: Ysgol y Ffwrnes sy'n ymuno â Ben Dant a Cadi i herio'r byd y tro 'ma. Ysgol y Ffwrnes joins Ben Dant and Cadi for a little adventure.

programme.title: Sion y Chef
programme.desc: Mae'n ben-lwydd priodas ar Mama Polenta ac Alf ac mae Siôn wedi cynnig coginio cyri a reis, ond mae bochdew Mario wedi bod yn cnoi'r reis! Oh no! Mario's pet hamster has been at the rice!

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach...
programme.desc: Byddwn yn dysgu am awyrennau yn y bennod yma, a phwy wnaeth ddyfeisio ac adeiladu'r awyren gyntaf. We'll learn about Aeroplanes in this episode, and about who invented the first one.

programme.title: Caban Banana Gareth

programme.desc: The Wetlands: Dive into the great floodplains that lie along the Drava River - areas that are at risk of intense seasonal flooding - before exploring the wetlands of Kopacki Rit. (2 of 2)

programme.title: Animal Empires
programme.desc: Family: Raising the next generation is the number one priority for every animal species. For some creatures, an entire village lends a helping hand, but others prefer to go solo. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Animal Empires
programme.desc: Rebuilding An Empire: The threat of extinction is all too real in the wild, but even against terrible odds, many animals fight back from the brink to continue their empires. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Battle Of The Alphas
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. The USA is big on spectacle, and so are it's animals; rams rattle mountaintops, brown bears battle and sharp-tailed grouse shake their tail-feathers. (S1, ep 9)

programme.title: Battle Of The Alphas
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. Europe's landscapes are often the backdrop to epic wildlife dramas; red deer go wild during the rut, wolf packs clash over territory, and foxes do the foxtrot. (S1, ep 10)

programme.title: Battle Of The Alphas
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. In the wide-open landscape of South Africa, wildebeest battle for herd hierarchy, fish fight it out on land and locusts give into a frenzy of cannibalism. (S1, ep 11)

programme.title: Battle Of The Alphas
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. South of the Sahara, male giraffes swing their heads like wrecking balls, zebras boast the most powerful kick in the animal kingdom and chimpanzees wage war. (S1, ep 12)

programme.title: Coral City
programme.desc: Autumn: Adapt or perish in the coral streets as higher-than-normal temperatures make autumn cooling (and survival) more difficult. (3 of 4)

programme.title: Coral City
programme.desc: Winter: Get chills as winter descends, slowing down life on the bustling reef. Meander with reef sharks and octopuses, visit a coral oasis atop an old shipwreck and more. (4 of 4)

programme.title: High Life In The Dead Mountains
programme.desc: In Austria's Totes Gebirge, a stark karst plateau of caves and dry peaks hides a rich ecosystem where wildlife thrives against the odds.

programme.title: Wild Science
programme.desc: Lion: From prehistoric predator to modern king, track the lion's epic rise. Science reveals fierce battles, tight bonds and the brutal tactics behind Africa's most iconic hunter. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Life's Journey
programme.desc: Life Begins: For the first few weeks of life, the world is a frightening place. Danger lurks around every corner and animals can't afford to let their guard down. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Life's Journey
programme.desc: Life Lessons: When young animals reach adulthood, their chances of survival increase hugely. But there are a lot of obstacles to overcome first. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Life's Journey
programme.desc: Life's Legacies: Every species on Earth faces the challenge of raising the next generation. In the wild, only the strongest will win at nature's mating game. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough
programme.desc: Hunters and Hunted: Follow great grey owls, kangaroo rats and more as they use sound to hunt and survive. (1 of 3)

programme.title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough
programme.desc: Love and Rivals: From melodic songs to strange hums, discover the sounds that gibbons, lyrebirds and more use to find a mate. (2 of 3)

programme.title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough
programme.desc: Finding a Voice: Follow baby animals as they learn to communicate to survive, using sound to call for help in their early days. (3 of 3)

programme.title: Jaguar Journals
programme.desc: Mum's the Word: Get to know Fera, the Queen of the Pantanal, as she teaches her rambunctious cub Simba how to climb trees and hunt for dinner. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Shark Squad
programme.desc: Bimini Sharklab: Travel to part of the Bahamas to unlock shark secrets, including their sociability, their bravery, and where they give birth. The answers may help protect them. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Wild Philippines
programme.desc: Discover a world shaped by fire and water as Philippine eagles soar above ancient forests and rare crocodiles lurk below the river's surface. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Wild Philippines
programme.desc: Dive into the wild Philippines as turtles and tiger sharks roam volcanic reefs and tarsiers leap through forests on the hunt. (S1, ep 2)
